decision: Reject the two-stage route without hardware. The pessimistic uncorrected scene begins at the already camera-verified torque-off pose with only 38.154 mm clearance, so a uniform 50 mm gate is impossible at row zero. Open one three-stage successor that first pans away to -60 degrees, then lowers shoulder lift, then restores the natural pan. Permit at most 0.5 mm clearance worsening relative to the immutable row-zero baseline while requiring no contacts in both scenes and at least 50 mm registered-scene clearance.
